name: 01_command_center
caption: Figure 1.1. Synthetic Command Center. A: page navigation. B: synthetic scope banner. C: coverage metrics and class chart.
notes: The page shows fictional catalogue counts and synthetic model metrics. It reports zero research predictions.

name: 02_technology_explorer
caption: Figure 5.1. Technology Explorer. A: search field. B: category filter. C: result table.
notes: The default table is a fictional synthetic catalogue.

name: 03_explorer_search_results
caption: Figure 5.2. Search result for DemoLang. A: exact text filter. B: filtered result. C: profile preview.
notes: Search uses case-insensitive literal text; no match displays a helpful empty state.

name: 04_technology_profile_overview
caption: Figure 5.3. Technology Profile. A: selected fictional technology. B: synthetic label. C: monthly activity history.
notes: The chart and label are generated demonstration outputs.

name: 05_profile_features
caption: Figure 5.4. Seven feature values. A: Health Score. B: Growth Momentum Index. C: question and enterprise measures.
notes: Read values using the nearby units. These demo formulae are not approved empirical definitions.

name: 06_profile_predictions
caption: Figure 5.5. Synthetic profile inference. A: model selector. B: generated class. C: class score table.
notes: There is no separate live prediction-generation page; this saved inference is attached to the selected synthetic profile.

name: 07_global_rankings
caption: Figure 6.1. Global Rankings. A: metric selector. B: category filter. C: ranked result. D: CSV download.
notes: Ranks describe the internally consistent synthetic scenario, not real-world technology leadership.

name: 08_community_health
caption: Figure 7.1. Community Health. A: fictional technology selector. B: generated activity timeline. C: discussion sample.
notes: No generated post is a real Stack Overflow post or research observation.

name: 09_enterprise_adoption
caption: Figure 8.1. Enterprise Adoption. A: technology filter. B: sector filter. C: organization search. D: synthetic records.
notes: Company names and relationships are fabricated examples, explicitly not verified adoption evidence.

name: 10_developer_sentiment
caption: Figure 8.2. Developer Sentiment. A: technology selector. B: measure selector. C: generated time series.
notes: The monthly values and sample counts are simulated, not survey responses.

name: 11_kenya_landscape
caption: Figure 9.1. Kenya-labelled synthetic scenarios. A: explicit warning. B: location filter. C: exported scenario rows.
notes: These are invented Kenya-labelled examples; the research database has no verified Kenya-specific technology observations.

name: 12_model_laboratory
caption: Figure 10.1. Model Laboratory. A: retraining action. B: metric selector. C: model selector. D: aggregate scores.
notes: Four saved synthetic model runs are displayed. Use class-level metrics before interpreting aggregate scores.

name: 13_model_class_metrics
caption: Figure 10.2. Per-class evaluation and confusion matrix. A: class precision/recall/F1. B: confusion matrix. C: CV folds.
notes: Declining recall is low on this imbalanced synthetic holdout.

name: 14_explainability_global
caption: Figure 11.1. Explainability overview. A: global mean absolute SHAP chart. B: synthetic scope warning.
notes: This explanation is for a generated feature panel and synthetic Random Forest only.

name: 15_explainability_local
caption: Figure 11.2. Individual synthetic explanation. A: technology selector. B: local feature contributions.
notes: Feature contributions are model associations, not causes.

name: 16_data_observatory
caption: Figure 12.1. Data Observatory. A: synthetic table counts. B: source and seed audit records.
notes: The page exposes generated lineage and table counts from the isolated PostgreSQL demo schema.

name: 17_methodology
caption: Figure 12.2. Methodology and feature definitions. A: seven synthetic formula descriptions. B: label-rule boundary.
notes: The SRS research rule and demo label rule are visibly distinguished.

name: 18_research_overview
caption: Figure 2.1. Research-mode overview. A: PostgreSQL status. B: real source coverage. C: prediction empty state.
notes: This is genuine research mode. Counts describe recorded source coverage; the page says research predictions are not currently available.

name: 20_research_rankings
caption: Figure 6.2. Research rankings metric selector and evidence boundary.
notes: The app withholds unsupported momentum values when the required time-aware community series is absent.

name: 21_research_community_validation
caption: Figure 7.2. Research community validation state. A: failed critical check. B: offending source evidence.
notes: The two invalid cumulative Stack Exchange rows block ingestion rather than being silently removed.

name: 22_research_prediction_empty
caption: Figure 11.3. Research Prediction Explorer. A: accurate message when no valid model run and feature snapshot exist.
notes: No research predictions are persisted; the warning is an intentional empty state.

name: 23_research_model_empty
caption: Figure 10.3. Research Model Performance. A: no valid PostgreSQL research run.
notes: Historical fixtures and synthetic demo scores are excluded from current research results.

name: 24_research_provenance
caption: Figure 12.3. Research Data Provenance and Quality. A: source registry. B: canonical row estimates. C: blocked-source record.
notes: The app is showing PostgreSQL provenance and status, not local synthetic SQLite rows.

name: 25_research_market_signals
caption: Figure 13.1. Research survey and skills view. A: year. B: geography. C: global-vs-Kenya evidence boundary.
notes: Global/unspecified survey information is not presented as Kenya-specific behavior; no verified training/job evidence is reported.

name: 26_research_live_empty
caption: Figure 13.2. Research live-intelligence empty state. A: explicit message when no live observations are recorded.
notes: No live technology observations are recorded in PostgreSQL.

name: 27_research_responsible_use
caption: Figure 13.3. Research interpretation and responsible-use notes.
notes: The page distinguishes observations, derived measures, missing evidence, predictions, and limits.

name: 19_research_technology_search
caption: Figure 5.6. Research technology search. A: canonical name search. B: stored evidence and prediction status.
notes: Searches the canonical PostgreSQL technology catalogue. Missing evidence remains unavailable.
